descricao_original: These secondary nodules in a tonsil demonstrate well-developed germinal centers capped by distinct mantles of unstimulated B cells. The nodule, which also contains macrophages and antigen-presenting cells, is supported by a stroma of reticular connective tissue. Tonsils filter tissue fluid in the mucosae of the oral and pharyngeal cavities. Pharyngeal tonsil, 200x
